hard.rule: MUST: v2 API backward compatibility must be maintained
MUST: All SQL must target PostgreSQL 16, not MySQL

soft.rule: PREFER: async write patterns where possible
PREFER: Favor composition over inheritance in new code

ask-first.rule: STOP and confirm with the user before: Database schema changes
STOP and confirm with the user before: Adding new dependencies to requirements.txt
STOP and confirm with the user before: Changes to the CI/CD pipeline

sacred.region: Proprietary tenant resolution logic, legally reviewed
GDPR audit trail, approved by legal
Historical migration files must never be modified

assumptions.unvalidated: Bottleneck is synchronous DB writes (validate against perf baseline)
Kafka cluster can handle 10M events/day without partition rebalancing
assumptions.validated: Current v2 API consumers do not use deprecated endpoints

brief.deliverable: Architecture doc with decision records, implementation plan with milestones, and working code with tests achieving >80% coverage on new modules.
